notes.title: Demo & Steam Page Now Live!
notes.content:
Demo & Steam Page Now Live! 


Step into the world of reclaimed goods and see if you have an eye for hidden gems in Salvage Shop Simulator!


[previewyoutube="wKj6DuylaJM;full"][/previewyoutube]


Our free single-player demo is now available - and the official Steam page is live!

In this vertical slice, you'll:

Join your first container auction


Search through salvaged items and bid against NPCs


Clean and appraise what you win


Sell items in your shop and set your own prices


Learn the core gameplay loop of acquiring, trading and growing your business!



Each container has been pulled from the water, and you only get 10 seconds to peek before bidding starts. Can you spot the treasure in the trash?

Reinvest your earnings, upgrade your store, and build your reputation as a top-tier salesperson.



Try the demo now and wishlist Salvage Shop Simulator!
Time to turn trash into treasure: 
Please remember that the Demo is an early alpha version of the game and may contain significant bugs.


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3555500/Salvage_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink]
